Rina: Hey team 1 tiny, glorious update: we officially hit $50,000,000 ARR this quarter!!! :tada: planning a quick rooftop + Zoom cheers at 5pm. Bring your best bad dad joke.

Carlos: WHOA congrats!! :raised_hands: thats bananas.

Maya: shoutout to infra for that autoscaler fix last week. Saved the launch. :heart_eyes:

Ishaan: snack poll time: bento boxes (🍱) or build-your-own sandwich board (🥪)? react with :banana: for bento, :bread: for sandwiches.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3.9 -> prod complete. No errors.

Noor: remote folks 1 can we please get a $20 meal stipend for joining? also karaoke on the agenda?

Rina: stipend approved. RSVP so we can send codes. Karaoke signups in the thread please.

Ethan: I will bring a tiny succulent named "Latency" as our mascot. Photo-op mandatory.

Zhanna: LOVE. Also proposing a ridiculous office trophy: a 3D-printed mini GPU with a ribbon. @Ethan want to sketch it?

Ethan: on it. maybe add a tiny disco LED strip that pulses with our p99 latency.

Maya: lol yes. Also quick shoutouts: @Ishaan for last-minute patching, @Carlos for customer comms during the spike.

Carlos: not without the whole ops team 1 y'all rock. :muscle:

Ishaan: proud of y'all. See you at 5 1 remote folks I'll ping the Zoom link and meal codes.

Rina: agenda: 5:00 rooftop pics and cheers, 5:30 quick band-aid retro (5 min), 5:40 karaoke (optional). add song choices under your name.

Zhanna: song: "September" by Earth, Wind & Fire. because energy.

Noor: remote karaoke pick: "Dancing Queen".

Ethan: bad dad joke for later: Why did the model cross the road? To get to the other inference.

Rina: I bow to that. Photos in #hall-of-fame after. Bring your party spirit and your best two-line shoutout for the recognition email.
